title: Clonal Hematopoiesis of Immunological Significance
official: Immuno-inflammatory Manifestations With or Without Clonal Hematopoiesis: Ambispective Cohort Study
summary: Ambispective, national, multicenter observational cohort study aimed at characterizing the satellite dysimmune manifestations of clonal hematopoiesis, including Vexas (Vacuoles, E1 enzyme, X-linked, Autoinflammatory and Somatic) syndrome.

sites.f: AP-HP, Service de médecine interne, Hôpital Saint Antoine
